title: AgentTurn
description: Output of the agent for one student turn. DRAFT from the MVP spec: change only by a PR approved by all three owners.

why.description: One-sentence explanation, written in the session explain_lang (en or fr).

rule.description: Optional fine-grained category of the mistake, for the Top mistakes screen. null or absent when unknown.

praise.description: Improvement 4: one short true positive about the answer (12 words max, checked by code), shown before the corrections. Null when the code refused it.

priority_index.description: Index in corrections of the fix shown in full; the others are folded. 0 when there is no correction.
